column1: # PRIVATE_NAME hits the public-content leak guard accepts, one row per (path, token).
# Format: path<TAB>sha256:<hex of token><TAB>count<TAB>reason naming an issue (#N).
# token is the lowercased alphanumeric run the hit matched; compute its digest
# with: printf %s <token> | shasum -a 256. count caps the hits, shrink-only like
# the baseline: more fails, fewer is reported so the count can drop.
# A path that itself spells a private name is given as sha256:<hex of the path>.
# A row no hit uses fails as stale; a duplicate (path, token) row fails.
# See #11535: these rows cover the deprecated settings and env-var aliases, kept
# with their deprecation warning; they and these rows go in the next major release.
